load: SELECT plan FROM public.gregale_compensation_plans WHERE identity=$1
reserve: INSERT INTO public.gregale_compensation_plans(identity,plan) VALUES ($1,$2::jsonb) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING plan
attempt: SELECT plan_id FROM public.gregale_compensation_attempts WHERE namespace=$1 AND request_id=$2::uuid
bind: INSERT INTO public.gregale_compensation_attempts(namespace,request_id,plan_id) VALUES ($1,$2::uuid,$3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING plan_id
effect: SELECT command_sha256,outcome FROM public.gregale_compensation_effects WHERE identity=$1 FOR UPDATE
run: SELECT plan_id,request_id::text FROM public.gregale_compensation_runs WHERE namespace=$1 AND run_id=$2::uuid
register_run: INSERT INTO public.gregale_compensation_runs(namespace,run_id,request_id,plan_id) VALUES ($1,$2::uuid,$3::uuid,$4) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING plan_id,request_id::text
